description: A grid of 24 arithmetic blocks, each taking an X value from its left and a Y value from above, and passing its results on to the right and downwards.

params.text: Picks the algorithm that block applies to its X and Y values and its constant; touch and drag to change it. With none picked, the X value passes to the right and the Y value passes down.
Sets the constant C that block's algorithm works with, -100 to +100.

inputs.text: The X value entering that row of blocks.
The Y value entering that column of blocks.

outputs.text: Carries the X value after the last block of that row.
Carries the Y value after the last block of that column.

notes: a block with no algorithm chosen passes its X value to the right and its Y value down, so the module changes nothing until you choose an algorithm for at least one block.
right-clicking an algorithm display gives Copy and Paste for that one algorithm, then a submenu for each category: Pass through, Addition, Subtraction, Multiplication and the rest.
menu: Copy — copies every block's algorithm and constant, for pasting into another A0 module.
Paste — writes the copied blocks into this module; it appears only after a Copy, and reads Paste (device too small) where the copied circuit uses more columns of blocks than this module has.
Visuals — a submenu of Blue, Dark and Light for the colour scheme, plus Flat for a look without the 3D shading. The choice covers every SubmarineFree module and is kept outside the patch.
